memories.text: The user's system reaches the internet only through the university network: archives, publishers and other educational resources are accessible, UDP traffic does not work, and some domains may be blocked.

fields.subject: university_network
fields.object: archives and publishers reachable; no UDP; some domains blocked

memories.text: Avoid UDP-based protocols and tools such as QUIC, HTTP/3 or UDP tunnels, because UDP does not work on the university network; use TCP alternatives.
When a website or download fails, consider that the university network may be blocking that domain before debugging further.
For papers behind a paywall, try the publisher's site or the archive directly from the university network before looking for other copies.
Microsoft Defender Edge runs on the user's system and may restrict certain sensitive activities.
If a sensitive action is blocked, do not retry it: the block may come from Microsoft Defender Edge; report what was blocked and ask the user.
Zotero runs locally on the user's system and holds the user's paper library.

fields.subject: zotero_library
fields.object: runs locally on the user's system

memories.text: Collect every paper found during research and send it to the user's Zotero running on the system.
When a paper is wanted, look in Zotero first to see whether it is already there, and search elsewhere only if it is not.
Get a paper: search Zotero by title, DOI or author; if it is missing find it online, add it to Zotero, then use the copy from Zotero.

steps: search Zotero by title, DOI or author
if it is missing find it online
